observations.purpose: verify noninteractive sudo authorization after user enablement
observations.effect_limit: Only /usr/bin/true was executed through sudo; no installer or service mutation occurred.

observations.purpose: read-only identity, selected existing service, and listening-socket inventory
observations.command_summary: sudo -n id; read-only systemctl show for cloudflared-hermes.service and hermes-pi-testd.service; ss -ltnp
observations.effect_limit: Inventory only. Foreign services and processes were preserved; no service, listener, account, or installation changes occurred.

observations.purpose: check sudo availability for reading the expected installed release and deployment roots
observations.command_summary: sudo -n stat and sudo -n namei checks of the fixed release/state/current-receipt paths
commands: sudo -n /usr/bin/stat -c '%n uid=%u gid=%g mode=%a type=%F links=%h' -- /usr/lib/hermes-installer/releases /var/lib/hermes-installer /var/lib/hermes-installer/deployments/current.json
observations.result: sudo was no longer noninteractive; no privileged root stat succeeded
observations.effect_limit: The attempted check did not stat or mutate the protected roots.

observations.purpose: unprivileged discovery of expected installer release and state paths after sudo expiry
observations.command_summary: stat and namei checks on fixed installer paths; no privileged execution
commands: stat -c '%n uid=%u gid=%g mode=%a type=%F links=%h' -- /usr/lib/hermes-installer/releases /var/lib/hermes-installer /var/lib/hermes-installer/deployments/current.json
observations.result: All queried installer release/state/current-receipt paths were absent; namei observed existing parent directories through /usr/lib and /var/lib as root:root 0755 and no symlink before the missing hermes-installer component.
observations.effect_limit: Unprivileged metadata lookup only; no installation or filesystem mutation occurred.

observations.purpose: recheck noninteractive sudo after a later user-reported enablement
observations.effect_limit: No command was run with elevated privileges; only a sudo availability check was attempted.
